setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer hears a young, inventive Dark Star [11]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Reviewer hears this version as fresh, tasteful and interesting [7]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the second Cryptical Envelopment as blistering, mind-melting improvisation, unmatched elsewhere [14]
- **New Potato Caboose** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best version of the song they have heard [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.86761.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 75 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd68-10-13.sbd.eD.10910.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 75 min; rated 4.68/5 by 19 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound is very good for its vintage; Some minor glitches in Feedback could not be removed [3][11]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.115606.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 73 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: The beginning of Dark Star is missing from this source; Reel flips occur during The Eleven and New Potato Caboose [6]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.owen.7772.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 75 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the show's freshness and restraint are unfortunately rare in the Dead's other performances [7]
- Reviewer names it their favorite show from this period of the band [8]
- Reviewer says the show shows how far the music had matured since the early days, and calls October 1968 possibly their best month [9]
- Reviewer ranks this show with 10/9 and 10/30 as evidence that October 1968 was a peak of that year [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.86761.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]
- **gd68-10-13.sbd.eD.10910.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Gans and Frisco; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer's own tape of this show, held over 25 years, degraded; the digital copy replaced it [9]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.115606.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [6]. Also: Joe B. Jones helped with pitch correction; Deadlists says KPFA broadcast tapes of 10/12/68 circulate mislabeled as 10/13 [6]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.owen.7772.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Michael Owen; source: MR>DAT>CD [2]
